title: Hiring signals
description: One record per company checked in this run.

name.title: Company
name.description: Company display name from the input.

source.title: ATS source
source.description: Which public board returned jobs: greenhouse, lever, ashby, or empty when none matched.

boardToken.title: Board token
boardToken.description: ATS board slug that worked for this company. Empty when none matched.

totalRoles.title: Total open roles
totalRoles.description: All published roles on the board. Zero when no board was found.

matchedRoles.title: Matched roles
matchedRoles.description: Open roles whose title matched a tracked function.

functionBreakdown.title: Function breakdown
functionBreakdown.description: Matched role counts by tracked function.

isBaseline.title: Baseline
isBaseline.description: True when this domain had no prior Key-Value state. Baseline runs do not treat open roles as new.

newRolesCount.title: New role IDs
newRolesCount.description: Matched job IDs present now that were absent from the previous stored set. Zero on baseline.

removedRolesCount.title: Removed role IDs
removedRolesCount.description: Matched job IDs from the previous set that are no longer open. Zero on baseline.

newRolesByFunction.title: New roles by function
newRolesByFunction.description: New job IDs grouped by tracked function.

signalScore.title: Signal score
signalScore.description: Weighted score (continuing × 0.5 + new × 3). Baseline treats all matched IDs as continuing so unchanged boards score the same every run.

meetsThreshold.title: Meets threshold
meetsThreshold.description: True when signalScore is at least signalThreshold.

verifiedContact.title: Verified contact
verifiedContact.description: Department email that verified as valid or risky. Empty when none worked or lookup was skipped.

contactStatus.title: Contact status
contactStatus.description: valid, risky, not_found, unknown, or skipped.

contactSource.title: Contact source
contactSource.description: Local-part pattern that worked: careers, jobs, recruiting, or hr. Empty when none.

matchedTitles.title: Matched titles
matchedTitles.description: Titles that matched a tracked function, with function and ATS job ID.
